title: Trading Foundations
outcome: From your first candle to your own trading plan.
intro: 10 chapters and 55 lessons of 3 to 5 minutes, based on the guide “Learn to Trade with Rico”. Free forever, and Lesson 1 needs no account.

chapters.title: How Markets Actually Work
chapters.promise: Why the bull and the bear never stop fighting, who you trade against, and the toll on every trade.
lessons: The six asset classes and their risk

practice.text: Read the headline, call it bullish or bearish. Uses Lesson 1.

chapters.title: Orders, Leverage & the Mechanics
chapters.promise: How a trade is actually placed, and the one tool that turns small mistakes into account-killers.
lessons: The four orders you’ll use 95% of the time
Long and short: profit both ways

practice.text: Place your first virtual trade with a limit and a stop. Uses Lesson 1.

chapters.title: Reading Charts
chapters.promise: Candles are the language of price: a diary of fear and greed.
lessons: Volume: the crowd behind the move
Support and resistance: where price pauses

chapters.title: Trends, Patterns & Indicators
chapters.promise: The map (trends, support, resistance) and the instruments (indicators) of technical analysis.
lessons: RSI: overbought isn’t a sell signal

chapters.title: Risk Management: The Real Edge
chapters.promise: The chapter that separates traders who last from traders who become cautionary tales.

chapters.title: Trading Psychology
chapters.promise: Your biggest opponent in the market isn’t a hedge fund. It’s the person staring back from your screen.
lessons: Fear and greed in your own head
Loss aversion: why you hold losers

chapters.title: Company Fundamentals
chapters.promise: Charts show how a stock moves. Fundamentals tell you what the business is actually worth.
lessons: Earnings per share and the P/E
Reading an earnings report in 5 minutes
chapters.tagline: Judge what a company is worth

chapters.title: Markets & the Economy
chapters.promise: Interest rates, inflation, jobs and growth: the tide that lifts or sinks every boat.

chapters.title: Building a Portfolio
chapters.promise: Single trades are battles. Your portfolio is the war.
lessons: Don’t put all your eggs in one basket

chapters.title: Building Your Trading Plan
chapters.promise: Everything comes together: pick your style and markets, write your entry, exit and risk rules, run a checklist and review every week.

skills.name: Chart Reader
skills.text: You passed the Chapter 4 Challenge. You read trends, trendlines and moving averages, and use one indicator per job.

skills.name: Risk Manager
skills.text: You passed the Chapter 6 Challenge. You size every trade from the stop and keep your head after a loss.

skills.name: Plan Ready
skills.text: You passed every Chapter Challenge and saved your five-section trading plan. You’re ready to test it with virtual money.

finale.requires: Pass all 10 Chapter Challenges and save your five-section trading plan.
finale.text: Your plan, a shareable certificate, 500 Profit Coins and +500 XP.
